summary: Fixed all attempt-2 A blockers with adversarial tests. Hardened Pi identity verification order, runtime/prompt containment against symlink races, whole-subtree cleanup for every controlled launcher outcome, and Sol fallback model enforcement. All focused, root, typecheck, and worker verification passes.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: The harness is physically separate from packages/worker-harness and never loads craft-pool.
evidence: packages/orchestrator-harness/package.json remains a pi-package with only orchestrator agents/skills.
No worker-harness or craft-pool imports were added in the F-phase diff.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Its decomposer emits only id, intent, change_spec, acceptance_criteria, and depends_on for each node.
evidence: src/domains/work-intake/decomposition-harness.ts validateCandidate() unchanged; exact-shape regression tests pass.
test/work-intake/decomposition-harness.test.ts rejects unknown top-level and node fields.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Kimi K3 is the bootstrap decomposition model with only approved fail-closed fallback policy.
evidence: test/f-blockers.test.mjs 'invoker passes exact Sol fallback model in Pi argv' proves Sol is the effective argv model.
test/work-intake/decomposition-harness.test.ts 'falls back to Sol when Kimi K3 is unavailable' proves routing selects fallback index 0.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: The invocation records prompt, model, tool, package, and code-graph revision provenance.
evidence: src/domains/work-intake/decomposition-harness.ts records piExecutable path/version/digest from the verified Pi executable.
test/work-intake/decomposition-harness.test.ts 'provenance records actual Pi executable identity' verifies the immutable Pi identity in the record.
test/f-blockers.test.mjs 'Pi digest is checked before --version executes' and 'run-decomposition verifies Pi identity before --list-models' prove pinned-digest verification precedes any Pi execution.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Schema-invalid output is rejected or repaired only within an explicit bounded policy; the model cannot validate, persist, approve, or dispatch its own DAG.
evidence: src/domains/work-intake/decomposition-harness.ts retains strict validation, response/node limits, one repair maximum, and invocation-wide deadline.
No persistence, approval, queue, Gate 1 or dispatch symbols introduced in F-phase changes.

risks: A narrow time-of-check/time-of-use interval remains between executable re-verification and operating-system spawn; the implementation re-verifies immediately before every initial or repair spawn and fails on any identity change.
Whole-subtree cleanup is best-effort in-process; uncatchable process termination can still leave the runtime parent behind.
Pi 0.81.1 model-selector semantics are an external runtime contract; the adapter uses --model with the provider-qualified ID.
The runtime-versions.json launcherDigest currently matches the Node.js test fake used in this repository; a production deployment must pin the digest of the actual Pi executable.
Previously documented residual risks remain: deterministic sanitization may miss novel secret encodings, and provider cancellation may lag the local timeout.
recommended_next_step: Hand to local-craft-evaluator on a different, not-lower-capability model for A/F/T review; if evaluator pairing cannot be enforced, fail closed and escalate.

findings_addressed: Critical: Pi bytes are executed before pinned identity is established, and the post-preflight process re-baselines an unpinned replacement. Addressed by verifying that pi-identity.mjs hashes bytes and checks the pinned digest before executing --version; f-blockers tests prove the --version marker is NOT written on digest mismatch and that run-decomposition verifies identity before --list-models; pi-model-invoker.mjs re-verifies identity immediately before every spawn.

High: The private runtime and prompt containment boundary remains caller-influenced and symlink-raceable. Addressed by runtime-parent.mjs hardcoding /tmp and validating ownership/mode/sticky-bit/directory-type/containment; f-blockers tests cover hostile TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP, lexical prefix collision, symlinked runtime parent, prompt directory symlink swap, and runtime parent symlink swap; pi-model-invoker.mjs revalidates runtime parent and prompt directory on every invoke.

Medium: Whole-subtree cleanup is not guaranteed for all controlled launcher outcomes, and the integration assertion does not inspect the actual runtime subtree. Addressed by converting launch.mjs preflight to async spawn with a tracked active child and cleanupAndExit on SIGINT/SIGTERM/child exit/child error/preflight failure; f-blockers tests assert the actual /tmp runtime subtree is absent after SIGTERM and after preflight digest failure; pi-model-invoker.mjs removes the whole prompt temporary directory.

Medium: Exact effective model selection is not demonstrated while a static Kimi default remains active. Addressed by removing subagents.defaultModel and fallbackModels from settings.json; f-blockers test asserts their absence and proves Sol is passed via explicit --model argv; work-intake tests prove routing selects Sol fallback index 0 and the invoker is bound to Sol.
